experiment: Causal fbank prediction-correction three-way feasibility pilot
selection_metric: free-running decoder corpus WER on the fixed model-selection subset
feedback: own corrected normalized states; detached between chunks; no teacher-state inputs
predictor: frozen deterministic FGN, one branch, one transition per chunk after the first; confirmed memory updated only from corrected states
scope: One-seed 100h student/distillation pilot; 100% encoder-output replacement on disjoint dev evaluation. Not an adaptive fallback/cache-recovery implementation or a matched-total-parameter comparison.
